claims.statement: The evidence contains four different reported building area figures for Kestrel Point Logistics Center, and they do not agree with one another.

citations.quote:
Kestrel Point Logistics Center is carried in the comparable set at a building area of 121,900
square feet.

claims.statement: Because the four sources report materially different building areas (128,400 SF, 133,750 SF, 121,900 SF, and 118,300 SF) for the same property, the evidence contradicts itself and no single reliable building area figure can be determined.

citations.quote:
a building area of 121,900
square feet
